envelope.note: Implemented slice B only. The task renderer change is the narrow compatibility needed for the required literal spend instruction in every harness prompt. Git staging/commit was unavailable because .git/index.lock could not be created on the read-only filesystem, so the launcher-ready commit message was written to out/COMMIT_MSG. Follow-up: otherwise-green suites emit pre-existing ResourceWarning messages for unreaped subprocesses and unclosed streams; this change does not address them.

commit.subject: dispatch: complete launcher recovery controls
commit.body:
Give implement jobs their declared wall, restore resumable session stores, and preserve resolved session evidence across failed resumes. Add verified collection for tripped write jobs, record-backed waiting, schema handoff, measured envelope spend, and project permission forwarding. Update the task renderer and governing lane contracts for the literal spend template.
